title: SG-6 In-scene object interaction anchored to the object, hotspot path removed
summary: Hovering or focusing a scene object shows a name plate and action buttons anchored to it, driven by content, with keyboard and screen-reader access.
description: Context: BootScene already builds SceneObjects from content, highlights them on hover or focus, and emits objectClick. The only on-canvas label is a Phaser Text showing the plain name. Actions appear in a separate ActionMenu panel that is not anchored to the object. Desired behavior: while an object is hovered or focused, a DOM overlay shows an upper-case name plate above the object and its content-defined actions (INSPECT, SEARCH, PUSH) beneath it. The overlay is anchored by a pure function of native position, scale, canvas offset and DPR, and is recomputed on resize. Every object and action is reachable by Tab, arrows, Enter and Space, with a live region and labels read from the same game state. Expected result: the old unanchored ActionMenu is replaced and no hotspot path remains. Why: the framed reference interface shows actions on the object.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object is hovered or keyboard-focused, When the overlay renders, Then a name plate above the object shows its content name in upper case and buttons beneath show its available action labels

Given the anchor inputs (native position, bounds, scale, canvas offset, DPR), When the anchor function runs, Then it returns the same screen point for the same inputs and a different point after the zoom or offset changes
Given a keyboard user presses Tab, arrows, Enter and Space, When focus reaches an object and its actions, Then each is reachable and activatable and the live region announces the focused object
Given the source tree, When searched, Then SceneView, HOTSPOTS and ASSET_PATHS do not appear in code or tests and the unanchored ActionMenu is no longer rendered

in_scope: DOM overlay with name plate and action buttons
Keyboard flow and ARIA live region
Removal of ActionMenu and leftover hotspot-path names
out_of_scope: Repository clean-up beyond the hotspot path
preserve: Existing focus store and keyboard handling in BootScene

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x (~3.90.0 pin and guard tests stay)
React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay
Keep the Go API contracts; no mock data in place of real API calls
Scene content stays data-driven: no object, position or asset id hardcoded in a scene class
One native scene resolution of 480x270, scaled by whole numbers only, nearest-neighbour
One shared palette of at most 48 colours used by art and UI
Tests are unit tests with every dependency mocked
definition_of_done: All four requirements delivered with unit tests passing
No ActionMenu or hotspot path remains
non_functional: Overlay recomputes on resize without layout thrash
